tei:div.tei:p: 69) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rig 'dzin byin 'bebs byin rlabs char 'bebs bdud rtsi'i thig le bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye: dbang dang byin rlabs sdud pa dang: snang rdor phyag rgyar sbyor ba'i phyir: byin dbab bdud rtsi'i thig le bstanaḥ dkyil 'khor sta gon gzhung bzhin bya: spos sregs dar g.yab rol mo dkrol: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrīḥ byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: dag pa gnyis ldan sku brnyes pa: kun bzang yab yum byin chen phobs: byin chen ngo mtshar= nges pa lnga ldan pho brang nas: ye shes gdangs lnga'i sku brnyes pa: rigs lnga yab yum byin chen phobs: byin chen= mi mjed sprul pa'i gnas mchog nas: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa: dga' rab rdo rjes byin chen= ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas mchog nas: chos nyid don gyi sku brnyes pa: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin= byin chen= zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nas: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa: padma 'byung gnas byin chen= byin chen= rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas: zag med bde ba'i sku brnyes pa: ye shes mtsho rgyal byin chen= 70) byin chen ngo mtshar= ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog nas: 'ja' lus dwangs ma'i sku brnyes pa: zhi ba mtsho yis byin chen= byin chen= chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas mchog nas: 'pho ba chen po'i sku brnyes pa: bī ma rasmis byin chen= byin chen= dag snang sprul pa'i gnas mchog nas: dbang lung man ngag kun gyi mdzod: rtsa brgyud bla mas byin chen phobs: hūm̐:hrīḥ snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing: mi shigs thig le lnga ldan dbus: rang byung rig pa padma 'byung: chos dbyings ngang las skur bzhengs la: gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol: chos dbyings ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: hūm̐ chen kā ra ston dang 'khor: chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la:

gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol: me long ye shes= 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ston= chos kyi dbyings= gnas 'dir byin chen= mnyam nyid ye shes= dha na saṃ skṛ ston= chos dbyings ngang nas skur= gnas 'dir byin chen= sor rtogs ye shes= klu sgrub snying po ston= chos dbyings ngang= gnas 'dir byin= bya grub ye shes= pra bha hasti ston= chos dbyings= gnas 'dir 71)rang byung ye shes= bi ma mi tra ston= chos dbyings ngang= gnas 'dir= kun khyab ye shes= rambu gu hya ston= chos dbyings ngang= gnas 'dir kun gzigs ye shes= shīntaṃ gharbha ston= chos dbyings= gnas 'dir= rang snang sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: rje 'bangs nyer lnga ston= chos dbyings ngang= gnas 'dir= gdan gsum rnam dag dkyil 'khor nas: yi dam zhi chags khro bo'i tshor: chos dbyings ngang= gnas 'dir= phrin las bzhi yi dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal chen bzhi dang ging lang bcas: chos dbyings ngang= gnas 'dir= bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas: 'jig 'das dam can gter bdag tshogs: gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin phobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: gzhan yang gnas mchog nyer bzhi dang: yul ni sum cu so gnyis dang: dur khrod chen po gnas brgyad na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog sgo gsum rdo rjer rlobs: gnas dang sgrub khang sgrub pa'i rdzas: zhing dang gzhal yas bdud rtsi ru: byin gyis brlab par 72)mdzad du gsol: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur la: byin chen rnams kyis byin phobs la: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po ston: ma g.yel ma 'gyang ye shes lha: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya e ā ralli pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥdzaḥ a we sha ya a a āḥ de ltar rig 'dzin byin 'bebs 'dir: brtson pas dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: the tshom med do rjes 'jug rnams:

da dung ma spel gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i tshe: shel dkar sprul bas chos 'di 'daun: bzang 'brel padma 'od du 'dren: ngan 'brel 'khor ba mtha' can 'gyur: chos kyi bdag po nyer lnga nas: bu slob stong phrag smin par nges: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: yal bar ma dor gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan bu dang 'di 'phrad shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: lha log mkhan gyi dbang po snubs: dam med rnams la gu hya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: ཿ zhes pa 'di yang dus ring mo nas brda don gsal yang gab 'khrugs 'tshubs lhongs shin tu che bas btang snyoms la bzhag kyang zab gter chos kyi bka' bab rang gi nye gnas dge btsun dam pa tshul khrims rdo rjes yang nas yang du zab gter gyi kha skong rnams 'bebs thub pa bka' drin ma chung zhes nan cher bskul ngor dus kun bse ru bzhin gnas pa gyi na ba gter rdzun su kha badzras mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus pa dge'o//
